note: SYNTHETIC DATA — fictional companies and numbers, created for this portfolio demo. Not real companies, not real pricing.

pages.text: Northwind Analytics offers three plans. The Starter plan costs $49 per month and includes 10,000 events per month. The Pro plan costs $99 per month and includes 100,000 events per month. The Enterprise plan has custom pricing and includes unlimited events and a dedicated support engineer.
pages.title: Northwind Analytics pricing

pages.text: Archived 2024 pricing for Northwind Analytics. The Starter plan cost $29 per month. The Pro plan cost $79 per month. Prices were updated in June 2025 and this page is no longer current.
pages.title: Northwind Analytics pricing (2024 archive)

pages.text: The Northwind Analytics API allows 1,000 requests per day on the Pro plan and 10,000 requests per day on the Enterprise plan. API responses are paginated with a default page size of 100 records. All API requests require an API key sent in the Authorization header.
pages.title: Northwind Analytics API documentation

pages.text: Northwind Analytics reported monthly churn of 4.2 percent in 2025, down from 5.1 percent in 2024. Net revenue retention reached 112 percent in 2025. The company now serves 1,200 paying customers, up from 850 at the start of the year.
pages.title: Northwind Analytics 2025 customer metrics

pages.text: Meridian Health deployed Northwind Analytics across 14 clinics in 2025. Reporting time fell by 40 percent after the rollout, from 10 hours per week to 6 hours per week. Data freshness improved from daily batches to updates every 15 minutes.
pages.title: Meridian Health case study

pages.text: Beta Ltd uses Northwind Analytics to monitor 3 million events per day. The team cut dashboard load time from 8 seconds to 2 seconds. Beta Ltd runs 45 dashboards for 120 internal users.
pages.title: Beta Ltd case study

pages.text: Northwind Analytics is SOC 2 Type II certified as of May 2025. Customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.3. The platform retains raw event data for 90 days and aggregated metrics for 24 months.
pages.title: Northwind Analytics security and compliance

pages.text: Northwind Analytics ingests events through Apache Kafka. The ingestion pipeline sustains 50,000 events per second at peak load. Events are validated, deduplicated by event id, and written to the warehouse within 60 seconds of arrival.
pages.title: Northwind Analytics ingestion architecture

pages.text: Acme Corp is a competing analytics vendor. The Acme Basic plan costs $59 per month. The Acme Pro plan costs $129 per month and includes 50,000 events per month. Acme Corp does not offer a free tier.
pages.title: Acme Corp pricing

pages.text: The Northwind Analytics engineering team has 42 engineers across data platform, backend, and frontend. The team ships on a two-week release cycle. The data platform team owns the Kafka ingestion pipeline and the warehouse models.
pages.title: Inside Northwind engineering

pages.text: Northwind Analytics retains raw event data for 90 days. Aggregated metrics are retained for 24 months. Customers on the Enterprise plan can request a custom retention period of up to 12 months for raw events.
pages.title: Northwind Analytics data retention policy

pages.text: Northwind Analytics integrates with Salesforce, Snowflake, dbt, and Slack. The Salesforce integration syncs customer records hourly. The Snowflake integration writes warehouse tables once per day.
pages.title: Northwind Analytics integrations
